goal: Scanner tuning review: rules that are noisy, rules that are missing and exclusions that have expired.
use: Scanner tuning review: rules that are noisy, rules that are missing and exclusions that have expired. Use when a scanner produces too many false positives or misses a known issue.

steps.note: List the rules enabled and disabled, with the reason for each.
Check noise. Rules that flag the same accepted pattern repeatedly.
Check gaps. Known issues the scanner should have flagged.
Check exclusions. Each exclusion needs a reason and an expiry.
Report. The rules to enable, disable or tune, with the reason for each.
